health.project_name: Phoenix Medical Campus - New HVAC Installation

sov_lines.key_assumptions: 70% shop fabrication; 30% field fab; standard material availability
Productivity assumes 70% in accessible ceiling; 30% open areas
DDC installation per controls contractor scope; point count per I/O schedule
Copper pricing based on current market rates
Clear site access; no coordination delays; standard PM staffing
Refrigerant pricing per current market; lineset routing direct
Insulation by specialty sub; pricing based on current bid
Programming based on approved sequences; 2 weeks for commissioning
Equipment selections per approved substitution list; long lead items ordered at NTP
TAB by certified balancing contractor; one mobilization assumed
Startup includes 2 weeks of system commissioning support
Submittals prepared in-house; standard review cycles
VAV/FCU counts per schedule; BACnet integration by controls sub
Chiller/boiler selections by owner; installation productivity assumes clear access
Closeout includes as-builts, O&M manuals, and owner training
